raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Alice is still focused on me. She's building roads toward the 3:1 port (Node 9) and the Ore port (Node 26). parsed.internal_thinking: Alice is still focused on me. She's building roads toward the 3:1 port (Node 9) and the Ore port (Node 26). I have 3 Wheat and she has nothing but threats, but the dice just rolled an 8, which gave her Brick and me nothing. I need to keep the charm up to deflect that robber.
parsed.note_to_self: Alice has roads to Node 9 and Node 26. She is short on resources for settlements but just picked up Brick on the 8. She is openly hostile toward my wheat production.
parsed.say_outloud: Watching them? Alice, I'd say they're more like community gardens. Plenty of room for everyone... eventually!
